title: RegulatoryCapitalFloor
description: R-Cap vs E-Cap per node with the Basel regulatory floor (RFL-1). Regulatory capital (Basel 8% x RWA) sits in parallel with the kernel's diversified economic-capital contribution; allocated_capital = max(economic, regulatory_floor). A node allocated at a diversified E-Cap that sits BELOW its regulatory minimum is REJECTED (McKinsey #38: you cannot diversify under the reg minimum silently).

target_capital_ratio.description: The asserted Basel capital ratio (8% == 0.08). Recorded on the receipt; R-Cap = target_capital_ratio x RWA.

economic_capital_contribution.description: Diversified Euler/marginal economic-capital contribution produced upstream by the kernel's euler_allocation over a coherent tail measure.

declared_allocated_capital.description: Optional: the capital the caller claims to allocate to this node. If below the regulatory floor it is REJECTED (silent sub-floor diversification).

regulatory.description: Basel regulatory-capital inputs. Either IRB (pd/lgd/ead[/maturity]) or standardized (rwa).
